levels.title: Select with WHERE
levels.task: The promotions team at Stellar Sound is making a highlight video for Sabrina Carpenter. List every column for all her songs on the chart so they can prepare the clips.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE artist = 'Sabrina Carpenter' ORDER BY id;
levels.hintMessage: Use WHERE artist = 'Sabrina Carpenter'. Add ORDER BY id so the row order matches the answer checker.
levels.successMessage: Great! You listed all of her songs.

levels.title: Select with WHERE Greater Than
levels.task: Your manager at Stellar Sound wants the biggest streaming hits: songs with more than 2 billion Spotify streams.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE spotify_streams > 2000000000 ORDER BY spotify_streams DESC, id;
levels.hintMessage: Use WHERE spotify_streams > 2000000000, then ORDER BY spotify_streams DESC, id.
levels.successMessage: Well done! These are the strongest numbers on the chart.

levels.title: Select with WHERE Dates
levels.task: A music blog is writing about older songs vs newer ones. At Stellar Sound they still use the same table—list every song with release_date before January 1, 2020.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, release_date FROM top_songs WHERE release_date < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY release_date, id;
levels.hintMessage: Compare dates with < '2020-01-01'. Use ORDER BY release_date, id so your rows match the answer checker.
levels.successMessage: Nice work! Now they’ve got all the data they need.

levels.title: Select with WHERE for Two Elements
levels.task: Your team at Stellar Sound is picking artists for a big outdoor festival. They want every artist name, but not Country and not Folk. Each artist should appear only once.
levels.solution: SELECT DISTINCT artist FROM top_songs WHERE genre != 'Country' AND genre != 'Folk' ORDER BY artist;
levels.hintMessage: Use DISTINCT artist, filter with genre != 'Country' AND genre != 'Folk', then ORDER BY artist.
levels.successMessage: Great! The festival list has no Country or Folk artists.

levels.title: Select with WHERE for 2 Different Elements
levels.task: The magazine team is writing about Morgan Wallen’s biggest album. At Stellar Sound, pull songs where the artist is Morgan Wallen and the album is "One Thing At A Time".
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, album_name FROM top_songs WHERE artist = 'Morgan Wallen' AND album_name = 'One Thing At A Time' ORDER BY track_name;
levels.hintMessage: Use AND for artist and album_name. ORDER BY track_name so the answer checker gets the same order.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! Now the feature can highlight just the right songs.
